acceptanceCriteria: Each named writer route writes its checkpoint/base outside the writer lock, with the same invalidation-token fallback JSG-V0-015 uses.
verifyWriterCheckpoint no longer does an O(store) compare under the lock, or its cost is measured and bounded.
A before/after measurement of bytes written and lock hold under the lock is retained.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1518 (storeperf-1021u, V1-0850, JSG-V0-015, seal a10038b51). commitLease now stages the read checkpoint and writer base outside the lock (about 2.1 MB per lease commit moved out on this repo's store; lock hold 84.7->51.8 ms at 880 tickets). Expected: the other writer routes (leaseWriter, mutateWriter, Mutate's complete route, refresh) stage the same way, and verifyWriterCheckpoint avoids an O(store) compare under the lock. Actual: they still write and compare in O(store) while holding the writer lock. Related: V1-0919 (optimistic observe).
title: Tasks leaseWriter, mutateWriter, Mutate complete and refresh still write checkpoints under the writer lock; verifyWriterCheckpoint compares O(store) under it
